We provide the following (logical) data sets:

1. **flight movements** information at 11 major European airports including
   a. **taxi-out time** for each movement in the airport
   a. **scheduled** and **actual** times

1. **airport coordinates** for all \acrs{ADEP} and \acrs{ADES}
